name: PHC Perfusion Calculator
description:
PHC Perfusion Calculator

A comprehensive, offline-capable clinical decision support tool designed for cardiovascular perfusionists and surgical specialists.

The PHC Perfusion Calculator is a robust web-based clinical utility modeled after the official Philippine Heart Center (PHC) Perfusion Section Standards and Guidelines. Built for reliability in high-stakes clinical environments, it operates 100% offline and empowers perfusion teams to perform instant, accurate calculations right at the bedside or in the operating room.

Key Features:
1. Patient Demographics & BSA: Automated Body Surface Area (BSA) calculations, estimated blood volume indexes, and age-adjusted MAP targets across adult and pediatric profiles.

2. Flow & Hydraulic Requirements: Real-time cardiac index flow determinations alongside hypothermia temperature-based flow tables.

3. Hematocrit, Transfusion & DO₂: Post-dilution Hct predictions, RBC volume deficits, pRBC transfusion requirements, and full-flow oxygen delivery tracking with critical safety alerts.

4. ACT & Electrolyte Corrections: Dynamic dosing algorithms for supplemental heparin, sodium bicarbonate (base deficit), potassium chloride,  and calcium supplementation.

5. Auto Tubing & Cannula Sizing: Intelligent size recommendations for pump boots, arterial/venous tubing, aortic root cannulas, EOPA, single-stage, dual-stage, and long venous cannulas.

6. Cardioplegia Protocol: Instant volumetric dosing breakdowns for Conventional (Adult/Pediatric), Del Nido, Lamelas, and HTK (Custodiol) cardioplegia delivery protocols.

7. Clinical Reporting: Built-in PDF/print report generation and local state persistence to streamline workflow documentation.

Designed for professional clinical use by trained cardiovascular perfusionists.
